facts.title: v-flow-exais

packages.name: @tt-a1i/archify-dsh
packages.description: Opt-in DeepSeek Harness Skill-only bundle for the Archify architecture-diagram skill.

packages.name: v-flow-exais
packages.description: V-Flow EXAIS - one Studio for typed architecture diagrams and real video production. Built from owned Archify and HyperFrames sources.

packages.name: @hyperframes/aws-lambda
packages.description: AWS Lambda adapter for HyperFrames distributed rendering — handler, client-side SDK, and CDK construct.

packages.name: @hyperframes/cli
packages.description: HyperFrames CLI — create, preview, and render HTML video compositions

packages.name: @hyperframes/diagram-engine
packages.description: Owned diagram compilation engine: typed JSON-IR renderers for architecture, workflow, sequence, dataflow and lifecycle diagrams.

packages.name: @hyperframes/diagram-motion
packages.description: Compiles guided-view semantic intent into deterministic, seekable motion on the composition timeline (contract C06).

packages.name: @hyperframes/diagram-viewer
packages.description: Standalone diagram viewer shell: the HTML template and viewer assets that wrap a compiled diagram artifact.

packages.name: @hyperframes/engine
packages.description: Seekable web page to video rendering engine (Puppeteer + FFmpeg)

packages.name: @hyperframes/gcp-cloud-run
packages.description: Google Cloud Run + Workflows adapter for HyperFrames distributed rendering — request handler, client-side SDK, and Terraform module.

packages.name: @hyperframes/player
packages.description: Embeddable web component for HyperFrames compositions

packages.name: @hyperframes/producer
packages.description: HTML-to-video rendering engine using Chrome's BeginFrame API

packages.name: @hyperframes/project-model
packages.description: Shared project envelope, document kinds, stable identities, command validation and atomic revision history (contracts C01, C03, C04, C05).

packages.name: @hyperframes/sdk
packages.description: Headless, framework-neutral HyperFrames composition editing engine

packages.name: @hyperframes/shader-transitions
packages.description: WebGL shader transitions for HyperFrames compositions

limitations: Static source inventory and declared package dependencies; runtime and deployment behavior are not inferred.
Dependency, generated, hidden, test and secret-bearing inputs are excluded. At most 10,000 paths and 8 MB of configuration evidence are inspected.
